purpose: Named database persistence design review. Native storage contracts, offline request conformance, backup coverage and live recovery are separate claims. No live certification is established by this matrix.

providers.nativeCreate: GraphQL templateDeployV2 for the reviewed official PostgreSQL template in the exact project/environment
providers.durability: PostgreSQL data directory must be inside the observed attached volume; image, service name and icon do not prove this.
providers.identity: projectId, environmentId, serviceId and attached volume identity
providers.completion: Wait for the exact template workflow Complete result, then observe exact service instance, attachment and mount/data-directory alignment before reporting a usable persistent database.
providers.recovery: Preserve existing identity and data on unknown reads; a missing or wrong mount requires reviewed recovery, never automatic replacement or an empty-volume attachment.
providers.prerequisites: Authorized project/environment, reviewed official database template, volume capacity and scoped private runtime references.
providers.coverage: Pinned GraphQL transport and database persistence regressions; no live restart/data-retention proof.
providers.runtimeReferenceEvidence: Exact scoped service variable names select the existing direct connection reference; only an absent local variable-name marker can be normalized through the isolated database-bindings stage. No credential values are persisted or fingerprinted.

freshInitializationRepair.prerequisites: Explicit one-use discardExistingData intent naming the exact bound service and complete project/environment scope, exact action confirmation, proven absence of any attached or pending volume, supported stock PostgreSQL 16 source/default startup and unchanged private issuer configuration. Require nonempty initializer password; preserve documented effective username/database defaults and matching aliases privately. Existing volumes, replicas, custom initialization settings and uncertain reads block.
freshInitializationRepair.nativeOperation: Additive PGDATA child-directory update with skipDeploys:true, volumeCreate for the exact project/environment/service and reviewed mount, then serviceInstanceDeployV2 for that same instance. Never create another service, delete old storage, replace the full variable map or create a public proxy.
freshInitializationRepair.completion: Require acknowledged volume ID, exact scoped volume-instance ID and attachment readback, acknowledged deployment ID correlated to the same service/environment, terminal SUCCESS and fresh mount/PGDATA readback. If the acknowledged deployment was removed, only read-only proof of an exact committed patch solely creating/mounting that acknowledged volume, one current successful activation, preserved immutable raw snapshots/source/startup/replicas and repeated identity/configuration checks permits a separately recorded activationReconciliation. Preserve the original deploymentId. Provider configuration and successful deployment do not prove SQL authentication, application schema, populated seed data or restart durability.
freshInitializationRepair.recovery: Persist encrypted private preparation and durable intent before mutation, then acknowledged volume/deployment IDs before dependent work. Uncertain writes retain a blocker and must not trigger another create/deploy or ownership-based cleanup. Preserve created storage after initialization may have begun; retry only from independently verified exact recovery evidence.
